'''Namene''' is a [[novice]] in the [[White Tower]]. 

== Appearance ==
She is tall and slim, and giggles incessantly.

== History ==
She is from [[Arad Doman]].

== Activities ==
She is one of the novices who has started calling [[Egwene al'Vere]] Mother behind the White Tower [[Aes Sedai]] backs.
